Input reference¶

Group

Purpose

$system

Memory, disk and scratch-directory limits.

$control

Job type, level of theory, basis-set file, Hamiltonian and printing.

$molecule

Charge, multiplicity, geometry (Cartesian and/or Z-matrix) and per-atom basis sets.

$guess

Initial guess for the SCF vectors.

$scf

Spin restriction, convergence, iteration limits and SCF solver.

$dft

Exchange–correlation functional.

$grid

Adaptive integration grid for DFT.

$integral

Integral evaluation for RI methods.

$atoms

Per-element core definitions for correlated (HF-based) methods.

$optimize

Geometry optimization, saddle-point search, IRC and relaxed scans.

$d2edr2

Numerical Hessian by finite differences of the gradient.

$thermo

Thermochemistry after a Hessian calculation.

$nmr

Reference shieldings and extra points for NMR shielding calculations.

$Energy

Results of an earlier run (energy, gradient, Hessian, dipole data), read back as input.

$dynamic

Molecular dynamics with a thermostat.

$uniq

Duplicate-structure filtering over several $molecule blocks.
